The hash brown patch is about 200 px across, roughly 11 cm. It is a shredded potato mass about 1.5 cm thick, so I estimate about 80 g. Fried hash browns run about 1.7 kcal/g, which gives roughly 140 kcal.

The sausage is about 165 px long, roughly 9 cm. It is a small link, possibly cut in half, so I estimate about 45 g. At about 3 kcal/g that is roughly 135 kcal.

Together that is about 125 g and about 275 kcal.
